resolution: Fixed the compiled route prop mismatch by extending the no-V8 instance stream and world_loader renderer beyond box/ramp rows. The compiler now emits prop parts as boxes, 8/16-sided cylinders, and spheres with full rx/ry/rz rotation, so dumpster lids keep their slope, stop signs bake as octagonal disks on poles, and bushes/rocks bake as clumped sphere parts instead of cuboids. The loader now batches and renders those shape ids in both monolithic and streaming paths. Verified with the hmsc-int bundle, direct world_loader ReleaseFast build, and tools/rjit game verify.
